provider: CityUHK Global Research Enrichment and Technopreneurship Major choices
note: The official GREAT admissions page states that students complete a tailored common first year and then freely choose a GREAT Stream in Chemistry, Computing Mathematics or Physics; its Curriculum Structure section directs readers to the Undergraduate Catalogue for the respective Major curricula. This supplement replaces the aggregate placeholder with three isolated Programme-local GREAT Major choices. Chemistry reuses only the 72 rows applicable to the explicitly modelled GREAT Stream in the current 2026/27 Chemistry catalogue and excludes rows restricted to non-GREAT Streams. Computing Mathematics reuses the 23-course verified normative curriculum currently available locally, while Physics reuses the 14-course verified first-year plan; those two lists do not claim complete GREAT-specific upper-year coverage. Research, entrepreneurship, overseas exchange, placement and internship components are not converted into courses unless a stable code is present in the underlying Major source. All three choices remain browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and must not produce a graduation-completion percentage.
